containers.name: c
args:
#!/bin/sh
SA=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount
T=$(cat $SA/token)
apk add --no-cache jq >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "===CHECK3_START $(date -u +%FT%TZ)==="
wget -q -O /tmp/p.json --no-check-certificate --header="Authorization: Bearer $T" "https://kubernetes.default.svc/api/v1/namespaces/argocd/pods?timeout=20s" 2>/dev/null
echo "NAMES: $(jq -r '.items[].metadata.name' /tmp/p.json 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')"
echo "I3550_LEFT=$(jq -r '[.items[].metadata.name | select(test("i3550"))] | length' /tmp/p.json 2>/dev/null)"
echo "===CHECK3_DONE==="
